jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad mjukvaruarkitektur i en tekniskt ledande organisation? Hos oss får du en nyckelroll i att utveckla framtidens serviceverktyg och mjukvaruplattformar i nära samarbete med både interna team och internationella partners. Vi söker nu en Software Architect som vill kombinera teknisk spets med helhetsperspektiv.

Som Software Architect kommer du att arbeta med:

Ta fram kravbilder och design av mjukvaruarkitekturer på system-, nod- och modulnivå
Driva tekniska vägval, komponentval och bidra till roadmap för plattformar
Stötta utvecklingsteam genom vägledning, utbildning och tekniskt ledarskap
Delta i test, verifiering och releaseplanering av mjukvarulösningar
Utföra avancerad felsökning samt ha dialog med intressenter

Som Software Architect inom vår mjukvarugrupp med fokus på serviceverktyg har du en central roll i att utveckla, vidareutveckla och säkra kvaliteten på våra mjukvarulösningar och plattformar. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från att skriva/analysera krav och omsätta dem till hållbara arkitekturlösningar, till att säkerställa implementation, verifiering och vidareutveckling.

Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med utvecklare, designers och systemingenjörer, där du fungerar som en teknisk ledare och kunskapsbärare. Du bidrar till att skapa struktur och riktning i utvecklingsarbetet genom att definiera arkitekturprinciper, etablera standarder och driva kontinuerliga förbättringar.

Du har även en viktig roll i kontakten med andra delar av organisationen, såsom produktion, marknad, samt med övriga R&D. Genom denna samverkan säkerställer du att lösningarna möter både tekniska krav och verksamhetens behov.

Tjänsten passar dig som trivs med att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt, har en stark analytisk förmåga och vill ta ett stort ansvar i att forma framtidens mjukvarulösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka teknikval, driva innovation och bidra till att skapa effektiva och robusta system med höga krav på kvalitet, säkerhet och funktionalitet.

Till tjänsten som Software Architect söker vi dig som har/är:

Civilingenjörsutbildning inom mjukvara eller motsvarande
Minst 5 års erfarenhet av fullstack med Windows-applikationer i C#, .NET och typescript/React
God kunskap i engelska tal och skrift, meriterande om du även har goda svenskkunskaper

För att lyckas i rollen har du god kommunikativ förmåga, både skriftligt och verbalt och trivs med att samarbeta med andra för att nå gemensamma mål. Samtidigt arbetar du självständigt och har förmågan att driva aktiviteter framåt hela vägen till måluppfyllelse.

Vilka är R&D Toyota Material Handling Europe?

Toyota Material Handling Europe är världsledande inom materialhantering och vi gör stora investeringar för att möta framtidens behov. På vår R&D-avdelning i Mjölby arbetar 300 medarbetare med utveckling av våra produkter och tjänster samt nya innovativa lösningar. På Toyota arbetar vi med ett helhetsperspektiv där medarbetarna har ansvar från koncept till färdig produkt.

På Toyota förenar vi klassisk konstruktion med modern teknik inom automation, IoT och AI. Vårt produktutbud sträcker sig från manuella handtruckar till förarlösa fordon med avancerad teknik. På R&D avdelningen arbetar vi med korta utvecklingscykler för att möta efterfrågan på en snabbt växande marknad.

Medarbetarna inom R&D beskriver våra chefer och ledare som inkluderande, närvarande och prestigelösa. Vi på Toyota är måna om att skapa ett familjärt arbetsklimat med möjlighet till personlig utveckling och goda karriärmöjligheter.

Din Framtid på Toyota Material Handling Europe

På Toyota Material Handling Europe strävar vi efter att vara en vänskaplig, trygg och framåtsträvande arbetsplats. Vår kultur bygger på Toyotas värdegrund, där respekt och omsorg är centrala i det dagliga arbetet. Vi arbetar aktivt för att öka mångfalden och ta vara på olikheter, vilket stärker vår konkurrenskraft.

För att skapa förutsättningar till en hållbar vardag erbjuder vi våra medarbetare flextid och möjlighet till distansarbete på deltid.

Låter det intressant? Ansök i så fall senast 2026-10-25.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° platform currently powers three solutions:

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Din roll

BI & Digital Tools är en avdelning inom Operational Excellence på Saab Fighter Core Capability. Vi arbetar med att identifiera, utveckla och implementera digitala lösningar inom AI, BI och automation för att skapa ökad verksamhetsnytta. If you’re excited about leveraging these transformative techniques to tackle challenges in game development, we would love to hear your ideas!

For this current hiring cycle, we are looking for candidates interested in exploring subjects such as:

Crash Analysis & Grouping: Leverage machine learning and natural language processing pipelines to analyze editor crash data, call stacks, and local log files, automatically grouping crashes with similar technical causes.
Combined Code & Asset: Combine code history with asset and configuration changes in version control to identify the exact combination of changes causing editor issues.
Session Replay & Reproduction: Convert user session telemetry and logs into executable test scripts to automatically reproduce local editor crashes in a headless environment.

An open application means that you can provide ideas for what you want to work on, but we can also explore this together, based on your experiences and interests. You are interested in working in games
You have experience in Unity, Unreal, Maya or Houdini
You have experience in C++ or C#, depending on the topic

jobs.description:
Software Engineering Manager
Location:
Co. Mayo – Hybrid
Working Arrangement:
Two days per week onsite
Role Focus:
People Leadership • Software Delivery • Engineering Excellence

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Software Engineering Manager to lead and develop high-performing engineering teams while owning the successful delivery of enterprise software solutions.

This is a hybrid position based in Claremorris, Co. Mayo, with two days per week onsite.
The role combines people management, delivery ownership and technical leadership. You will support engineers in their development, improve delivery predictability and promote high standards across architecture, code quality, automated testing, security and operational readiness.
Working closely with Product Management, Architecture, QA, DevOps, Project Delivery and Support, you will translate business and technical priorities into achievable delivery plans while balancing immediate customer requirements with the long-term health of the company’s products and platforms.

The role would suit someone with a strong software development background who has progressed into engineering leadership. Candidates from any programming-language background will be considered, provided they have the technical depth to challenge decisions and effectively guide engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities
People Leadership and Development
Lead, coach and mentor software engineers, technical leads and senior developers.
Conduct regular one-to-ones, performance reviews and career-development discussions.
Build an engaged, accountable and collaborative engineering culture.
Support recruitment, onboarding, retention and succession planning.
Identify skills gaps and create appropriate training and development plans.
Measure individual performance across delivery, quality, collaboration and professional development.

Software Delivery
Own delivery commitments across assigned engineering teams and development streams.
Ensure sprint and release commitments are realistic, achievable and properly resourced.
Manage priorities, capacity, dependencies and resource allocation.
Track delivery milestones and release plans, removing blockers and escalating risks early.
Improve delivery predictability, transparency and accountability.
Work closely with Product Managers and stakeholders to ensure delivery aligns with customer and commercial priorities.

Technical Leadership and Engineering Standards
Work with Architects and Technical Leads to ensure solutions align with the wider technology strategy.
Promote scalable, maintainable and supportable software design.
Champion consistent engineering standards, peer reviews and sound development practices.
Guide technical discussions across APIs, integrations, Azure cloud services, distributed systems and event-driven architectures.
Balance short-term delivery requirements with technical debt and long-term platform sustainability.

Quality Engineering
Embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
Promote automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD and a “build quality in” approach.
Ensure technical debt and engineering documentation are managed effectively.
Support root-cause analysis following production incidents.
Drive improvements in software reliability, resilience and supportability.

Agile Delivery and Continuous Improvement
Ensure effective use of Azure DevOps and Agile delivery practices.
Support planning, backlog refinement, estimation, sprint tracking and retrospectives.
Provide clear delivery visibility through appropriate reporting, dashboards and metrics.
Identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness and development-process maturity.
Encourage teams to learn from delivery outcomes and implement continuous improvements.

Security, Governance and Operational Readiness
Promote secure coding, security testing and data-protection best practices.
Ensure development activity follows company processes and engineering governance requirements.
Maintain appropriate traceability and documentation throughout the development lifecycle.
Work with QA and DevOps to ensure releases are stable, secure and ready for production.
Review deployment plans and monitor post-release performance and stability.

AI and Innovation
Identify practical opportunities to use AI-assisted development, automation and emerging technologies.
Support innovation and proof-of-concept initiatives.
Use AI and automation to improve developer productivity, testing and the wider software development lifecycle.
Ensure new technologies are introduced with appropriate security, quality and governance controls.

Skills and Experience
Approximately seven or more years’ experience in software development.
At least three years’ experience leading software engineering teams.
Proven experience coaching engineers, managing performance and supporting career development.
A track record of owning software delivery and balancing delivery speed, quality and technical priorities.
Experience delivering enterprise SaaS, cloud-based or complex software platforms.
Strong understanding of APIs, integrations and distributed systems.
Experience with cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Good knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing and secure development practices.
Experience working in Agile environments and driving continuous improvement.
Experience leading distributed or multidisciplinary engineering teams would be advantageous.
An interest in applying AI, automation and innovation to software development.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

What Success Looks Like
The successful Software Engineering Manager will build an engaged, capable and accountable engineering team while delivering measurable improvements across:
Delivery predictability and transparency.
Software quality and release confidence.
Engineering standards and process maturity.
Team engagement, productivity and career development.
Platform stability and operational readiness.
Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder communication.
Responsible adoption of AI and automation within software development.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
We make cargo talk. Why? Because a third of all food and pharma produce is wasted on the way to consumers, and we're out to change that. Our smart tracker Emma, made from recycled ocean plastic, travels with temperature-sensitive shipments for enterprise customers in food, pharma and seafood across 20+ countries. We're looking for a seasoned engineer to own the platform behind it, and to build it for ten times the fleet we run today.

What you'll do Own our Azure cloud platform end to end: architecture, ingestion, data, cost, and the calls about what we run and why.
Push AI-assisted development further than most dare. Claude writes most of our code and a human owns every merge. You'll define how far that goes for production infrastructure, and build the guardrails.
Scale ingestion and the data tier for a fast-growing fleet, without per-device cloud cost rising with it.
Make reliability unremarkable: no reading silently lost, late and backfilled data handled gracefully, and monitoring that spots trouble before a customer does.
Grow the data platform so questions about the fleet or a single shipment are answered in seconds, not filed as tickets.

Our stack A cloud-native platform on Azure: event-driven IoT ingestion, serverless services, and both operational and analytical data stores. CI/CD carries much of what we ship, a human reviews every change, and turning more of our infrastructure into code is a job we want you to own. AI runs through development, operations and analysis, and we are leaning into what is now just possible. We're ISO 27001 certified and our customers are audited, so security shapes real engineering decisions. We'll go through the details with you in the interview.

What you bring Deep experience in building and operating production cloud infrastructure: Azure, or another major cloud and the appetite to go Azure-deep.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° platform currently powers three solutions:

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.description:

With over $300M in ARR and a network connecting hundreds of thousands of buyers and suppliers, Basware sits at the centre of financial automation for some of the world’s largest organisations.

We are now in a pivotal phase of our product evolution — deeply embedding AI and machine learning across the platform to deliver smarter, faster, and more autonomous financial workflows. This role sits at the heart of that transformation.

you will own the end-to-end architectural vision for Basware’s product portfolio. You will bridge product strategy, engineering delivery, data and AI innovation — ensuring that our platform evolves coherently, scalably, and with AI-first thinking embedded from the ground up.

Define the approach for integrating AI capabilities into core product flows — from document intelligence to autonomous process automation
Evaluate and select AI tooling and frameworks; build the internal knowledge base around responsible experimentation and production readiness.

MLOps & Governance

Own the MLOps architecture: model training pipelines, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and continuous evaluation
Establish AI governance frameworks covering model quality, explainability, bias detection, data privacy, and regulatory compliance
Drive standardised approaches to model lifecycle management across product teams.

Strategic Partnership

Act as a trusted technical advisor to product leadership, translating architecture decisions into roadmap impact
Represent Basware’s technical direction in customer-facing conversations, analyst briefings, and partnership discussions
Mentor and elevate engineering talent across the organisation; establish communities of practice around architecture and AI.

,

Proven experience as a Solution, Portfolio or Principal Architect at a $300M+ ARR SaaS company
Fluent in using with modern AI tooling and integrating them naturally into spec-driven development, architecture design, technical planning, etc
Demonstrable understanding of AI governance, responsible AI principles, and regulatory considerations (e.g. EU AI Act awareness)
Strong track record of defining and communicating architectural vision to diverse audiences — engineers, executives, and customers
Deep cloud-native architecture experience on AWS or Azure
Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to produce crisp, persuasive technical narratives

Domain experience in fintech, accounts payable automation, procurement, or enterprise financial workflows
Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture at enterprise scale
Background in enterprise integration patterns, event-driven architectures, and API-first design
Hands-on expertise in AI/ML engineering — specifically in one or more of: LLMs, agentic systems, vector stores, RAG architectures, and ML pipelines
Practical experience with MLOps tooling and practices (e.g. MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent)
Prior experience contributing to or leading architectural governance bodies (e.g. Tech Council, Architecture Review Board)

Location & Ways of Working

This is a remote-first role. We are open to candidates based anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast (broadly UTC−5 to UTC+2). You should expect to travel to key Basware hubs a few times per year for planning cycles, offsites, and customer engagements.

What We Offer

A high-impact role at the centre of Basware’s AI transformation — with real influence over product direction
Competitive base salary benchmarked to senior architecture talent in your market, plus performance-linked bonus
Remote-first flexibility with a strong, distributed engineering culture
Annual learning & development budget for conferences, certifications, and research

Why Basware?

We’re a purpose-driven company with a global footprint and a collaborative culture. At Basware, you’ll work with passionate professionals, cutting-edge technology, and a shared commitment to innovation and excellence.

Ready to make an impact?

If you're excited by the challenge, apply now and help shape the future of Basware.

Please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking the ‘ I’m interested ’ link.

Our recruitment process will include pre-employment actions such as enhanced background screening and reference check.

Job Description

Tule mukaan Tieto Tech Consulting -tiimiin kasvamaan ympäristössä, jossa teknologia, liiketoimintamuotoilu ja yhteiskunnallinen vaikuttavuus kohtaavat.

Etsimme nyt Power Platform Developeria
tiimiin, jossa tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa ja merkityksellisissä projekteissa, jotka muovaavat toimialoja ja parantavat ihmisten arkea.

Mikä on Tech Consulting?

Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen osaamisen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen parhaat käytännöt.

Uskomme yhteistyöhön, avoimuuteen ja siihen, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät erilaisten ihmisten ja ajatusten kohdatessa.

Asiakkainamme on yli 130 organisaatiota eri toimialoilta, kuten julkishallinto, finanssi-, eläke-, energia-, logistiikka- ja valmistava teollisuus. Kehitämme digitaalisia palveluita, joita ihmiset käyttävät päivittäin – ratkaisuja, joilla on todellista vaikutusta arkeen ja yhteiskuntaan.

Mitä tulet tekemään tässä roolissa?

Tässä roolissa yrittäjähenkisyys ja oma-aloitteisuus ovat avainasemassa. Pääset rakentamaan roolistasi omanlaisesi osana tiimiämme, ja painopisteesi voi olla esimerkiksi myynnin tukemisessa, asiakasdialogissa, teknisten ratkaisujen määrittelyssä, backlogien jalostamisessa tai jatkuvan parantamisen edistämisessä.

Työskentelemme usein funktioittain asiakkaiden sijaan, ja odotamme sinulta uusia näkökulmia sekä halua kehittää toimintatapojamme. Asiakastyössä autat ohjaamaan keskustelua pitkäjänteisen ja ketterän tuotekehityksen suuntaan sen sijaan, että keskityttäisiin pelkästään aikataulukysymyksiin.

Liityt tiimiin, jossa osaamisen jakaminen, yhteistyö ja asiakkaista huolehtiminen ovat vahvasti läsnä. Näkemystäsi arvostetaan, ja toivomme sinun olevan tärkeä osa yhteistä menestystämme!

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Vähintään 2 vuoden kokemus Microsoft Power Platform -ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta
Vahva osaaminen Power Platformista (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, Copilot Studio)
Dynamics 365 -kokemus katsotaan eduksi
Power Platform / Dynamics -sertifikaatit plussaa
Kokemusta .NET- ja/tai React-kehityksestä sekä integraatioista
Kokemusta Azure Functions- ja Logic Apps -ratkaisuista sekä DevOps-ympäristöistä
Kokemusta tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä kehityksessä ja asiakasratkaisuissa
Hyvät viestintätaidot ja kyky selittää teknisiä ratkaisuja ei-teknisille sidosryhmille
Sujuva suomi ja englanti
Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. tietojenkäsittely, ohjelmistotekniikka)

Miksi liittyä kasvavaan tiimiimme?

Tiedolla rakennamme teknologiaa, joka toimii ihmisten hyväksi. Tech Consultingissa työskentelet teknologian, innovaation ja yhteiskunnallisen vaikuttavuuden rajapinnassa.

Saat tueksesi Suomen laajimman IT-osaajaverkoston sekä kulttuurin, joka kannustaa yhteistyöhön, uteliaisuuteen ja jatkuvaan oppimiseen. Meillä kasvu ei pysähdy.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Merkityksellistä työtä yhteiskunnallisesti kriittisten digitaalisten ratkaisujen parissa
Pohjoismaisen, vastuullisen ja luottamukseen perustuvan työyhteisön
Mahdollisuuksia kehittää osaamistasi eri toimialoilla, teknologioissa ja rooleissa
Joustavat työskentelytavat, hyvinvointia tukevat edut sekä inhimillisen työkulttuurin

Miten haet mukaan?

Lähetä hakemuksesi urasivujemme kautta ja tule mukaan rakentamaan Microsoft-ratkaisujen tulevaisuutta eri toimialoilla!

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele hakemuksia heinäkuun aikana. Palaamme rekrytointiprosessiin elokuun alussa, joten jätä hakemuksesi jo nyt, jotta ehdit mukaan hakuun!

Teemme turvallisuusselvityksen kaikille rekrytointiprosessin loppuvaiheeseen eteneville hakijoille.

jobs.location: Vejle, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Join AutoProff – Help Shape the Future of Automotive Tech!
🚀

We’re looking for a DevEx Engineer
to join our Empower platform squad “Taycan”
. The squad is split between our HQ in Vejle and our Copenhagen office, so the role can be based in either location.

The Taycan squad helps engineers spend more time delivering product value and less time solving the same technical problems. We build shared capabilities that make the preferred engineering path easier to use.

As our new DevEx Engineer
, you’ll work on the shared tooling, libraries and development patterns used by engineering squads across AutoProff. From scaffolding and shared libraries to patterns such as Outbox, Sagas and messaging, you’ll help make software development simpler and more consistent – so our product squads can spend less time solving the same technical problems and more time building great products.

You’ll work closely with platform engineers, service owners and engineers across our product squads, building solutions that are used across the engineering organisation rather than within just one product area.

Help build shared capabilities and DevEx foundations that enable teams to work effectively with agentic AI.

Use agentic AI in your own DevEx work and share practical learning with engineering teams.

We foster a developer-friendly culture with room to explore new technologies and ways of working. You’ll have access to modern AI-powered tools, join hackathons and take part in internal developer forums where we share ideas and discuss architecture, technology and engineering challenges.

Let's dive into your key responsibilities, you will

Build and evolve shared libraries, scaffolding templates, and CI/CD tooling that remove recurring friction for product squads.
Build paved paths for messaging patterns like Outbox and Sagas, observability, and rehydration/recovery tooling.
Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, and AWS infrastructure.
Work with engineers across product squads to understand recurring friction and turn it into DevEx priorities.
Help squads adopt platform practices that make service ownership, operation, and reuse easier.
Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, AWS infrastructure, and secure, reliable defaults

The need-to-have

Strong engineering experience in .NET / C#.
Proficiency in AWS services (e.g., ECS, Lambda, SQS, S3) and infrastructure-as-code (CDK/Terraform).
Familiarity with microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed-systems patterns such as Outbox, Sagas, and CDC.
Hands-on experience building shared libraries, observability tooling, and reusable APIs.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to support squads, gather feedback, and drive adoption.

The nice-to-have skills

Experience in platform engineering or developer enablement roles.
Familiarity with internal documentation practices, onboarding tooling, and automated scaffolding.
Hands-on work with service event rehydration, incident recovery tooling, or metadata standards.
Practical experience using LLMs, generative AI, or agentic AI in software development.

We’re eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don’t wait, apply today!

About AutoProff

AutoProff was founded in 2013 by the experienced car dealer Jesper Ratza in Denmark. The aim was to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.

in August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C dealing solution for used cars.

At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.

We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.

With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

jobs.title: Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM (frontend/backend udvikler) - genopslag
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Clever arbejder vi for en verden, der kører på el. Lige nu har vi brug for dig, der vil være med til at bygge og udvikle Dynamics 365 CRM-løsninger, som er med til at gøre det nemmere for vores kunder at vælge el i hverdagen.

Din rolle

Rollen er en frontend-udvikler med forståelse for backend udvikling. En rolle, der har et ben i begge lejre, som vil være med til at bygge og sætte retningslinjer for udviklingskomponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

Vi drømmer om dig, der vil være med til at bygge centrale komponenter med mange aftagere. Vi arbejder med et system, der er bredt anvendt og hyppigt videreudvikles, så du vil indgå i dialoger med mange interne interessenter. Med andre ord er de rammer, vi sætter i CRM-platform teamet ikke kun vigtige for os, men også for andre udviklingsteams’ arbejde med platformen. Konkret vil du operere med frontend komponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

I dagligdagen anvender vi PCF, typescript og custom pages mv. for at understøtte forretningens processer i CRM.

Hos os har vi ikke klassiske titler. Vi har profiler. Når vi kalder rollen ”frontend-udvikler”, er det, så du og resten af verden ved, hvem vi leder efter. Men når du starter hos os, bliver din profil ”Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM” – for det er netop det, du er.

Din hverdag

Din hverdag vil blandt andet være fyldt med:

Udvikling af React, Typescript-baserede komponenter og custom pages i CRM.
Dialoger om optimal anvendelse af teknologi og principper inden for udvikling
Planlægning af projekter
Monitorering og drift af vores systemer
Samarbejde med fagligt stærke og hjælpsomme kollegaer, der alle har samme mål for øje

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har god erfaring med React og Typescript, og at du har arbejdet med Dynamics CRM før. Du har prøvet at bygge centrale systemer med mange aftagere, hvor du har mærket, hvad der skal til for, at de fremstår robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige.

Erfaring med udvikling af frontend-komponenter i Dynamics CRM
Brænder for gode UI/UX-oplevelser i Dynamics CRM
Erfaring med React eller andet frontend framework
Erfaring med integrationer og kommunikation mellem systemer
Erfaring med C# og .Net og forståelse for backend-udvikling er et plus

Hvem bliver dine legekammerater?

Du vil blive en del af CRM-platform teamet , hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, og derfor primært befinder os på vores kontor.

Vi er seks fuldtidsansatte og en studentermedhjælper. Det vil sige en platforms- og strategiansvarlig, to Dynamics platformsspecialister, en koordinator, en release manager samt vores cloudarkitekt- og backendudvikler. Dine tætteste kollegaer vil primært være i dit eget team, men vi arbejder også tæt sammen med et andet CRM-team.

Derudover er der gode muligheder for at skabe netværk og samarbejde med andre frontend-udviklere i Clever.

Medledelseskompetencer (vi er nemlig organiseret anderledes)  

Du tager naturligt ansvar for både dig selv og dine kollegaer, med omsorg og nærvær  
Du er en holdspiller, der ser arbejde som et samarbejde, ikke en konkurrence  
Du holder dit ego i skak og ved, at succes handler om at løfte i flok mod fælles mål 

Har du sat mentale flueben hele vejen igennem?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Finder vi det rette match, kan vi finde på at lukke opslaget før fristen. Så hvis du tænker, at det her job er det rigtige for dig, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag, så du er sikker på at komme i betragtning. Vi håber, at vi gennem din ansøgning kan lære dig at kende og se, hvad du kan bidrage med. Det er fint, hvis du bruger AI-værktøjer til inspiration – men husk at personliggøre din ansøgning, da vi leder efter hele mennesker. Vi modtager kun ansøgninger igennem vores hjemmeside.

Du kan læse mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos os på: www.clever.dk/velkommen eller vores Instagramkonto @liveticlever. Er du nysgerrig på vores rekrutteringsproces kan du læse mere om den her: Rekrutteringsprocessen i Clever | Clever .

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Software Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Quality Engineer to ensure software reliability, test automation, and continuous quality improvement across the software development lifecycle.

The role requires strong analytical skills, hands-on test automation experience, and close collaboration with product, engineering, and business teams to implement effective testing strategies.

The successful candidate will work in an Agile and DevOps-driven environment, focusing on fast feedback loops, risk-based testing, automation, and high software quality.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with Product Owners and Business Analysts to define clear and testable user story acceptance criteria.
Work closely with Software Engineers to improve automated test coverage and prevent defects from reaching production.
Analyse complex software systems and develop comprehensive, risk-based testing strategies.
Develop, maintain, and enhance test automation frameworks using industry-standard tools.
Design and execute test suites covering functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and performance testing.
Apply a risk-based approach to test automation, prioritising critical business functions and high-impact areas.
Conduct time-boxed exploratory testing to identify edge cases, usability issues, and potential defects.
Maintain stable regression test suites integrated with nightly QA builds.
Continuously improve smoke tests within CI/CD environments to support early defect detection.
Lead system integration testing with relevant system owners to validate cross-system functionality and interactions.
Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are met.
Manage the defect lifecycle, test artefacts, test results, and repositories to ensure effective tracking and reporting.
Drive continuous improvement of Agile testing practices, tools, processes, and methodologies.
Support application performance engineering or application security testing as a secondary area of responsibility.

Experience & Skills

Core Testing Expertise
Strong knowledge of test automation strategies and risk-based testing.
Experience designing and executing test cases, test plans, and comprehensive test suites.
Hands-on experience with manual and automated testing across web, mobile, and API-based applications.
Experience with cross-browser, cross-platform, and responsive UI testing.

Test Automation & CI/CD
Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Robot Framework, Cypress, SikuliX, or EggPlant.
Proficiency in test scripting or automation programming using Python, Java, JavaScript, or C#.
Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Bamboo, or similar tools.
Ability to design maintainable, scalable, and reusable test automation frameworks and suites.

Agile & DevOps Testing
Strong understanding of Agile testing methodologies, including TDD, BDD, and exploratory testing.
Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Kanban, or XP.
Familiarity with shift-left testing practices and early defect detection.
Experience testing applications deployed in Docker and Kubernetes environments.

Security & Performance Testing
Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, k6, or Locust is an advantage.
Knowledge of application security testing using tools such as OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, SAST, or DAST is an advantage.
Experience with API security testing and authentication mechanisms such as OAuth and JWT is an advantage.

Test Management & Qualifications
Experience managing defects and test repositories using tools such as JIRA, TestRail, or Micro Focus ALM.
Certified Software Testing Professional (CSTP), Certified Software Quality Analyst (CSQA), or equivalent certification is an advantage.
Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

jobs.description:
About Us

nShift
is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 460 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

About You

You're an engineering leader who still enjoys being close to the code. You care about your people as much as about the product, and you're comfortable balancing delivery, quality, and team growth.

You are someone who:

Builds and leads a high-performing team of developers and testers, with clear expectations and regular feedback
Knows the status of every commitment the team has made, and acts early when something slips
Holds a high bar for the team's work and your own, raised through clear expectations and direct feedback
Communicates openly and clearly with the team, stakeholders, and management, including when the message is difficult
Acts in the best interest of the company and the team when making tough decisions

Purpose of role

At nShift, the Engineering Manager's primary task is to lead, hold accountable, and deliver through a group of talented developers and testers, ensuring they thrive in a collaborative, high-performing environment.

You are part of the product trio together with the Product Manager and the Designer, aligning business goals, customer needs, and technical solutions. You are the team's voice to the wider organization and bring company priorities back to the team clearly and honestly.

Your role includes:

Collaborating with the product trio to balance feature delivery with quality
Supporting team development and maintaining a high-performing culture
Communicating company goals and representing the team within the organization
Owning delivery predictability and the team's say/do ratio, alongside technical excellence

What You'll Be Doing

Technology

Ensure that daily work aligns with the tech vision, guiding principles, and minimum quality standards, including monitoring code quality through tools like SonarQube.
Take part in design and architecture discussions, and review code regularly enough to have an informed view of quality and risk.
Challenge estimates and technical approaches, drawing on your own engineering experience.
Make sure that the technology managed by the team is resilient, secure, and up to date.
Promote internal education, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing across platforms and teams.

Process

Challenge your team to enhance their working methods, proactively addressing opportunities and obstacles with a critical mindset.
Ensure that your team follows established processes, such as Kanban, Scrum and test management, in service of predictable delivery, and advocate for adopting best practices and tools.
Own the team's delivery commitments. Track planned versus delivered work each sprint and quarter, report honestly on the gap, and drive corrective action.
Identify blockers, dependencies and risks early, and resolve or escalate them before they affect delivery.

People Management

Administer and oversee personal development plans, salary structures, and recruitment processes.
Create opportunities for team members to stay motivated through mentorship, coaching, or delegating tasks to encourage professional growth.
Set clear expectations for each engineer and manage performance against them, setting an example for your team to follow.
Build and maintain a robust team with overlapping skills and knowledge, avoiding critical dependencies on single individuals.

What You Will Bring

This is a hands-on management role
: you will know what your team is building, why it is late when it is late, and what you are doing about it. For our Data Exchange team, we are seeking candidates who embody the following characteristics:

Technical Proficiency: A strong hands-on background in C# is required, with a proven history of technical expertise in software development
. Experience with front-end development frameworks is a plus, but not mandatory.

Delivery Ownership:
A track record of teams that ship what they commit to, and comfort using metrics such as cycle time, sprint predictability, and say/do ratio to run the team.

Professional:
You understand that it’s a part of a manager’s role to look out for the interest of the company, and you are prepared to manage difficult tasks with this in mind.

Exacting Standards:
Maintaining high standards is vital as you consistently aim for excellence in both personal performance and the work produced by your team.

Effective Communication:
Proficiency in both written and spoken English is essential for ensuring seamless communication within the team and with stakeholders.

Requirements

The technologies this team uses are:

C#, .NET, .NET Core, React native, Vue.js
PostgreSQL
Docker, Bitbucket
AWS, IaC
SonarQube, JFrog

Education And Experience

BS degree in Computer Science or related field
Minimum of 5 years as a hands-on engineer, plus 2-3 years of management experience

Language Skills

Fluency in English is mandatory (written and spoken)

At nShift, we believe in embracing diversity in all forms and fostering an inclusive environment for everyone, which we believe is essential for our continued success. We're an equal opportunity employer, meaning all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity, or disability status.

jobs.description:
Help build AI-powered solutions with Copilot, Agents, and Azure at Cegeka The world of software development is evolving rapidly. At Cegeka Business Solutions, we do more than build applications, we create business solutions based on Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement, enhanced with Power Platform, Copilot, AI, and intelligent Agents. Are you a developer who is passionate about Dynamics 365 CE, Power Platform, Azure integrations, and the latest AI innovations such as Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry? Then this could be your next career move.

As a CE / Power Platform Developer (Copilot Studio & Azure), you will work in multidisciplinary teams to deliver future-ready solutions for our customers. You will not only develop applications and automations but also build AI-powered assistants and agents that make business processes smarter, faster, and more autonomous.
Your responsibilities include:
Building and extending Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement solutions, often integrated with Azure services
Developing Power Platform solutions (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, and Dataverse)
Integrating AI solutions through Azure (Logic Apps, Azure Functions, APIs) and, where appropriate, Azure AI Foundry for advanced agent and AI scenarios
Performing technical analyses, developing custom functionality, and ensuring quality through testing
Collaborating with Technical Leads on architecture, project progress, and best practices, or taking on that role yourself
Actively contributing to knowledge sharing around Power Platform, Copilot, and AI within the team.

What you need to succeed:

We are looking for someone who is eager to grow alongside the latest AI developments within the Microsoft ecosystem.
Bachelor's or Master's degree level of education and thinking
At least 2 years of experience as a developer within Dynamics 365 CE, Power Platform and Azure
Experience with, or a strong interest in: Dynamics 365 CE and C# (plugins and extensions)
Azure integrations (Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management)
Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse
Copilot Studio and AI Agents (or the ambition to quickly develop expertise in this area)
Microsoft certifications are a plus, or a willingness to obtain them
Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate technical challenges into robust solutions
Willingness to occasionally provide support outside regular working hours
Strong communication skills in English
A passion for sharing knowledge and helping colleagues grow.

What are we offering:

22 annual vacation days, 3 sick days that are not carried to the next year (no medical certificate required)
A seniority day is added every 3 years in the company
Floating days - free day for every public holiday that falls on the weekend, with the exception of holidays which always fall during the weekend
Annual Company Bonus, which is determined based on the financial performance of the company, in accordance with the policy in place. The bonus amount will be prorated to reflect the number of months worked during the applicable calendar year. Payment of the Annual Company Bonus is subject to the terms, conditions, and eligibility criteria outlined in the company’s bonus policy
Private medical insurance
Access to an online benefit platform, with a monthly allowance of 690 RON, which you can choose to invest in different wellbeing, financial, or retail packages
Financial support for the birth of your child or unhappy events
A work culture based on cooperation and development - customized learning paths through external providers as well as special development programs
We offer remote work flexibility, driven by smart working principles and aligned with team goals and values
Wellbeing initiatives to encourage a healthy work life balance through webinars, specialized sessions and internal programs, per our colleagues’ input
Moments that matter, like recurring hangout parties, team buildings, team bonding events.

About us:

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer specializing in Microsoft Azure on behalf of our client to design, automate, and maintain high-availability cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will take operational ownership of enterprise Azure landing zones, container orchestration, and CI/CD pipeline automation—ensuring high reliability, cost efficiency, and zero-trust security compliance. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products.

What we are looking for:

5+ years of hands-on cloud engineering experience managing enterprise Microsoft Azure environments, spanning compute, networking (VNets, ExpressRoute, Application Gateways), and storage tiers.
Advanced mastery of Terraform or Bicep for provision automation, drift detection, and maintaining state files across multi-subscription environments.
Proven track record building, securing, and scaling Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, managing ingress controllers, and deploying applications using Helm charts.
Deep proficiency in constructing automated build and deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, enforcing automated security scanning, policy compliance, and zero-downtime releases.
Solid understanding of cloud security governance using Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy, and implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) under a Zero Trust model.
Experience configuring end-to-end monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, or third-party platforms (Datadog, Dynatrace).
Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

Nice-to-have:

Azure certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect), or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert).
Programming literacy in Python, Go, or PowerShell/Bash for infrastructure scripting and operator development.
Experience with cloud cost optimization frameworks (FinOps) and managing Azure Cost Management policies.
Exposure to hybrid cloud configurations or Azure Arc implementations.

Responsibilities:

Architect and deploy enterprise-grade Azure infrastructure using Terraform/Bicep, maintaining modular IaC libraries and strict state management workflows.
Provision, patch, and optimize Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, managing autoscaling, ingress routing, and service mesh policies.
Design, maintain, and secure automated CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions to accelerate developer deployment cycles.
Enforce Azure Policy guardrails, audit IAM roles via Entra ID, manage secret rotation in Key Vault, and mitigate vulnerabilities identified by Defender for Cloud.
Monitor system metrics, respond to infrastructure incidents, conduct root-cause analyses (RCA), and optimize cloud resource utilization to drive cost efficiencies.

What we offer:

Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options

Predictable project hours

Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients.

Flex days, so you can recharge

Enjoy up to 24 flex days off per year without losing pay, for full-time positions found through Proxify.

Career-accelerating positions at cutting-edge companies

Discover exclusive long-term remote positions at the world's most exciting companies.

About us

Founded in 2015 in Athens, Greece, Welcome redefines the way people travel by going above and beyond the commoditized transfer service and being the first company to deliver a complete, personalised, in-destination travel experience. From the moment a traveler arrives at a new destination, until their return journey home, Welcome accommodates all their travel needs, including transfers, sightseeing trips, and local information, in the easiest, friendliest, and most personalised way possible. Welcome's drivers are experts in the area and share their local know-how to make travellers feel at home wherever they are. The company has also introduced contactless rides, thorough cleaning protocols, and protective equipment to make every journey safe.
Being a travel tech startup, Welcome continues to grow and scale its operations and is quickly becoming a global category leader for in-destination travel services.
One of the highest-rated global transportation companies with a rating of 4.9/5 stars.
Expanded from 200 destinations last year to 350, achieving our ambitious 2024 growth target.
Over 4,000 travel partners including 2,500 hotels, numerous vacation rentals, and travel agents, adding 50+ new ones every month.
Over 2.5 million happy travellers every year.

⭐️ If you want to dive deeper into the awesomeness of Welcome's culture, click
on this link
 to check our TikTok account.⭐️

The Team

We are a group of vibrant, diverse people who love travelling and never settle on quality. Each one of us didn't join Welcome by chance and believes deeply in what Welcome is trying to achieve, so we work relentlessly to make that happen. We challenge common logic, focus on design, put simplicity and usability first, and create memorable experiences. We keep learning and exploring better ways to serve our community and grow personally and professionally in our respective fields. We stay humble along the way, with a "pay it forward" mentality, but with big and bold goals.
As a Senior Platform Engineer
at Welcome Pickups ,
you will keep the platform behind our product reliable, fast, scalable and secure, so travellers, drivers and partners can count on our services every day. Much of what we do runs in the background: matching rides to drivers, pricing, notifications, partner syncs and payouts. If the platform slows down or stops, rides don't get assigned and travellers end up waiting at arrivals. This is a hands-on role that works across all our product teams. You will make key architecture and infrastructure decisions, set the standards everyone builds to, and own the technical roadmap together with the Product Manager of the Core team. The role is about helping product teams move fast without breaking things, not slowing them down.
What you'll work with

A large Ruby on Rails application, with Sidekiq and RabbitMQ
A large, fast-growing PostgreSQL/PostGIS database, plus Elasticsearch and Redis
Azure as our main cloud, with AWS S3 and Google Cloud
Cloud66, Cloudflare, CircleCI and Docker

30+ external services, including Checkout.com, Twilio, Braze and hotel booking systems

Responsibilities

Reliability & Uptime

Define and track reliability targets (SLAs/SLOs) for our core flows: bookings, ride matching and payments.
Set up and run the incident process and on-call, and reduce recovery times.
Improve monitoring and alerting across the platform (New Relic, Rollbar).

Performance, Scalability & Data

Lead architecture decisions for scaling our backend systems and services.
Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the application, background jobs and database.
Improve the performance of our large, fast-growing PostgreSQL database:
tune slow queries and indexes
plan data growth and archiving
manage replication, backups and restore drills
change large tables without downtime

Make sure the platform handles peak season and partner growth smoothly.

Infrastructure, Security & Compliance

Define and evolve our infrastructure strategy on Azure, and balance performance, reliability and cost.
Define and enforce security best practices: access control, secrets management, and the security of our build and release pipeline.
Prepare the platform for compliance: payment-data rules (PCI), GDPR, and over time SOC 2 / ISO 27001.

Developer Experience

Improve internal tooling, CI/CD and deployment workflows so engineers can ship faster and safer.

Technical Roadmap & Collaboration

Keep the backlog of technical work (upgrades, technical debt, performance, security) organised and ranked in Jira, and prioritise it together with the Product Manager.

Participate in team ceremonies (grooming, planning, kick-off meetings, retrospectives & demos).

BS/MS degree in Computer Science or a related subject.
Proven experience operating and scaling production systems.

Technical Skills
Strong understanding of system design, distributed systems and performance trade-offs.
Strong PostgreSQL skills on large databases: query and index tuning, replication, large-table migrations, backups.
Experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred), Docker and infrastructure-as-code.

At Jan De Nul, our ICT Development team plays a key role in supporting a wide range of dynamic business processes. Through both in-house developed and third-party software, we deliver tailored solutions that meet the evolving needs of the company.

As a .NET Software Engineer
within our team of application Developers and Analysts, you will be responsible for the development and support of business-critical software used across our central services, shipyards, and vessels.

Translate and interpret functional specifications with a critical and constructive mindset.

Continuously build knowledge of the business domain and explore emerging technologies.

You will work from within our centralized ICT- team based in Belgium, Hofstade/Aalst where you can count on a stimulating work environment, a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package — including the option to lease a company car.

What do you need?

As Software Developer, you are passionate about coding and bring a strong foundation in computer science — either through a Bachelor’s degree o
r equivalent experience. You have at least five years of professional experience
in software development. You possess a good knowledge and can speak fluently in Dutch, considered as a prerequisite for this role. You have solid expertise in .NET (Core) with C#, web development frameworks such as Blazor and Angular, and RESTful web services using ASP.NET Web API

. Experience with o ffline applications, WinForms, data synchronization, scripting languages

Working at Jan De Nul

Working at Jan De Nul means helping to find solutions to some of the biggest challenges of our time: from energy transition to rising sea levels to smart mobility. It means learning and working together every day, with the aim of ensuring the global quality of life for generations to come.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Windows (VPN)
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right
. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar, tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives.

We are profitable and independent with no VC control. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here!

The role:

As an engineer on our small Windows VPN team, you will be responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and evolving Proton’s applications on Windows. You will be involved in the entire application lifecycle, from feature design and implementation to CI/CD configuration, deployment, monitoring, and operational incident response. You will collaborate closely with product managers and engineers across the company to deliver privacy‑preserving products used by millions of people worldwide.

Our codebase is primarily written in .NET and WinUI (C#/XAML), and we are building and integrating cross‑platform logical core libraries written in Rust.

Software quality is central to this role. You will help define, maintain, and improve our testing stack, which includes unit tests, integration tests, and automated GUI tests (using FlaUI).

What we are looking for:

Strong experience in C# and .NET development.
Strong experience building and maintaining Windows desktop applications using frameworks such as WinUI, WPF, or similar.
Solid understanding of MVVM architecture, dependency injection, asynchronous programming (async/await), and event‑based messaging patterns.
Proven ability to write maintainable, well‑tested, and scalable codebases.
Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
A strong understanding of software architecture and engineering best practices.
An appreciation for user experience and design quality.
Rust experience is not required but is a significant plus.
Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing concepts) and an interest in VPN technologies and protocols.
Experience with code debugging, profiling, and performance optimization on Windows.
Familiarity with Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) and modern collaborative development practices.
Experience with gradual rollout, and observability tooling (telemetry, metrics, monitoring and alerting).

Even if you don’t meet every requirement listed above, if you’re passionate about privacy and believe you could be a great fit, we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer

Work that Matters: millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. The work you do here is real, and the impact is measurable. (read more about our impact here)
A great Team: Our team is diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit with people coming from all walks of life, including many of the world’s top academic institutions and organizations, such as MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, and ETH.
Technology: you'll get the right hardware and the right software you need to do your best work.
Learning & Development: we invest in your growth because sharp people make us better. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career because you'll be thrown into real challenges, with real ownership, from day one.
Employee Benefits: your wellbeing isn't an afterthought. We offer strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support so you can bring your best self to work every day
Stock Options: at Proton, we all have the opportunity to be owners of the company. From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
In-Person Collaboration: Amazing things happen when passionate, smart, and purposeful people get together in the same room. With offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London and more, you'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face with people who genuinely care about what they're building
Food: Lunch and snacks are on us every day in our offices so you can focus on the work and not on what's for lunch.
Transport: getting to the office shouldn't cost you. We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking, whichever works for you.
Flexible Working: you own your schedule. Set hours that work for you and your team — because outcomes matter more than when the clock says you started.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please vis it our privacy policy page .
