jobs.title: Senior Product Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us at Wolters Kluwer and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day. We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most.

We are currently looking for a Senior Product Software Engineer
to join our team.

Mission:

Take your software engineering career to the next level as a Senior Product Software Engineer. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and troubleshooting software programs. Your technical skills and innovative mindset will contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, making a significant impact on user experience and satisfaction.

Responsibilities:

Software Development: Participate in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software applications to meet project requirements.
Design Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define design specifications and details, taking into account diverse perspectives.
Effective Communication: Regularly communicate project updates, progress, and challenges to stakeholders and team members.
Technical Documentation: Prepare detailed technical specifications and requirements documents to guide the development process.
Performance Optimization: Identify bottlenecks and optimize software programs to improve overall performance and efficiency.
Application Design: Participate in the design of innovative and user-friendly software applications that align with customer needs and industry standards.
Testing Strategies: Create comprehensive testing routines and procedures to ensure the reliability and accuracy of software applications.
Applied Problem Solving: Utilize mathematical principles and statistical approaches to solve intricate problems in scientific or applied fields within software projects.
Issue Resolution: Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve complex information technology issues that may arise during development.
Data Preparation: Prepare and preprocess data for analysis, ensuring its accuracy and readiness for use in software applications.
Technical Support: Provide technical support to end-users, including assistance with software maintenance, troubleshooting, and usage queries.

Skills:

Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test the software, and resolve any software-related issues.
Software Development: The ability to design, write, test, and implement software programs, applications, and systems. This includes understanding various programming languages, software architecture, and software testing methods. It also involves problem-solving capabilities to fix software issues and improve functionality.
Programming: The ability to design, write, test, debug, and maintain the instructions, also known as code, that a computer must follow to execute a task. This skill often involves various programming languages such as C# and Angular.
Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and ultimately choosing and implementing the most effective course of action.
Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them down into smaller parts, and understand how these parts work together.
Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process, often in software or product development. It involves the ability to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality.
Agile: The ability to swiftly and effectively respond to changes, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and flexibility. In the context of project management, it denotes a methodology that promotes adaptive planning and encourages rapid and flexible responses to changes.
Source Code Repository: The ability to effectively use a source code repository, a file archive, and a web hosting facility where a large amount of source code, for software or for web pages, is kept, either publicly or privately. This skill involves the ability to manage and track changes to code, identify and fix issues, merge code from different branches, and collaborate with other developers.
Non-Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate a non-relational database (MongoDB).
APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage Application Programming Interfaces, which constitute the set of protocols and tools used for building application software. This skill includes the capacity to create and maintain high-quality API documentation, implement API security practices, and understand API testing techniques. Additionally, having this ability means understanding how APIs enable interaction between different software systems, allowing them to communicate with each other.
Design: The ability to create, conceptualize, sketch, and implement layouts, structures, and plans either for aesthetic or functional purposes. This could be used in various contexts such as architecture, fashion, graphics, interior, and more. It involves creativity, problem-solving, and strategic thinking.
Framework: The ability to understand, utilize, design, and develop complex structures and systems in various contexts such as programming, project management, or business strategy. This ability requires critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
Documentation: The ability to create, manage, organize, and maintain important information and documents in various physical and digital formats. This skill may include preparing reports, managing files, storing data, and keeping records organized and updated for easy retrieval and understanding.
Advanced Technology Adoption and Utilization: AI Tool Proficiency: Evaluate and optimize AI tool usage for team efficiency and productivity; AI Output Validation: Establish validation standards and review processes for AI-generated code; Responsible AI Usage: Lead responsible AI initiatives and establish team best practices; and Agentic Workflow Design: Design and optimize AI agent workflows for team efficiency.

Competencies:

Analytical Skills
Inclusive Collaboration
Drive to Perform
Accountability
Functional Expertise
Operational Expertise

If you think that you have the needed requirements click on the apply button to join us and be the difference
. If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or any other protected status, in accordance with local regulations.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
At Materialise Medical, we believe that better healthcare starts with solutions designed around the individual patient. If you’re passionate about bringing personalized care to every patient, you’ll love being a part of this team. Through the technology we develop, researchers, engineers, and clinicians are revolutionizing personalized treatment — helping improve and save lives daily.

Mimics Flow is our innovative case management solution designed to streamline personalized patient care. By providing full visibility and control over every step of the workflow—from request to approval—Mimics Flow empowers surgeons and hospitals to deliver high-quality results while ensuring seamless compliance with local regulations.

As part of the Mimics Flow platform, you will play a key role in shaping the architecture of our new service, Mimics Workflow, a standalone product that integrates seamlessly into the platform. We are looking for a  Software Architect
 who combines technical expertise with strategic vision and exceptional communication skills to ensure the success of this new service and its alignment with our mission.

What You Will Do

Define and manage the architecture of one or more applications in the Mimics Flow platform.
Provide implementation strategies, work decomposition, and technology recommendations.
Serve as the technical and architectural point of contact for your team, sharing best practices and mentoring team members.
Collaborate with product management, stakeholders, and other teams to define and defend the technical roadmap.
Represent your team in the Materialise group of architects to align solutions across departments.
Maintain architecture documentation and contribute to cloud-related initiatives.
Actively participate in agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Your Profile

Technical Skills

You have experience with/working knowledge of: .NET Core, ASP.NET, Entity Framework, and Automapper. Designing modern cloud-native applications, including Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and DevOps practices. Cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and related tools, such as Kubernetes, Docker, and Amazon Storage. Walking up the cloud stack (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) using modern terminology and relevance. Designing and developing integrations and interactions with other systems and applications.
You are familiar with networking technologies and DevOps tools related to software solution design, including REST, gRPC, GraphQL, and Terraform.
You are familiar with front-end technologies, such as TypeScript, NodeJS, and React.
Knowledge of BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) is a plus.

Soft Skills

Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with product management, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
Confidence in negotiating and defending architectural decisions and technical roadmaps.
A proactive mentor who shares best practices and inspires the team toward technical excellence.

Mindset and Culture Fit

A strategic thinker with a helicopter view, capable of aligning technical solutions with business priorities and long-term goals.
Familiarity with agile working methods (Scrum, Kanban) and enthusiasm for contributing to a self-organizing team.
Passion for Materialise’s mission to scale additive manufacturing across industries, from aerospace to medical, and drive Industry 4.0.

What’s Waiting For You

Work that matters

The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day.

At Materialise, we expect you to think about the customer, not just the task. You push for better solutions and care about the difference your work makes.

A people-centered space

When you join Materialise, you join a group of colleagues invested in you, not just your work. From your own team to a department across the world, you’ll find a sense of belonging with people who help without being asked, challenge you, and have your back.

At the same time, we expect you to invest in the people around you — not just your own work — to make the group stronger than the sum of its parts.

An environment of trust

As a company of innovators, we know how crucial autonomy is in your work. When we hire you, we trust in your expertise, giving you space to organize your tasks, work flexibly, and make your own calls.

At Materialise, we expect you to deliver on that trust and keep your commitments.

A career ready to build

When you see opportunities for your career to grow at Materialise, we encourage you to go for them. People shape a fulfilling career at their own pace here.

At Materialise, we expect you to take initiative in your own development. Don’t wait for someone else to plan your career. Step into the space and make it count.

Make a difference together with the Medical team.

Formarás parte del área de arquitectura, dando soporte a proyectos de transformación cloud, IA y sistemas agénticos, API management, seguridad IT y workplace, en un entorno multirregional y regulado.

Diseñar remediaciones a nivel de proyecto cuando la deuda técnica o incumplimientos afecten a la solución
Entregar la arquitectura as-built y la información de traspaso a los equipos de aplicación, operaciones y repositorios

Entre 8 y 15 años de experiencia en arquitectura de solución, arquitectura de aplicaciones o ingeniería de software senior, incluyendo al menos 5 años siendo responsable de diseños end-to-end llevados a implementación
Experiencia en arquitectura de solución end-to-end: aplicación, integración, datos, seguridad, cloud/infraestructura y operaciones
Capacidad para traducir requisitos funcionales y restricciones en una arquitectura implementable, con análisis de opciones y trade-offs documentados
Dominio de patrones de integración API, service-oriented y event-driven: contratos de interfaz, dependencias y flujos de datos

To rola dla osoby, która lubi automatyzować, porządkować standardy i budować platformę, z której korzystają inni.

Nad czym będziesz pracować:

Będziesz rozwijać wspólną platformę Microsoft Azure wykorzystywaną przez wiele zespołów, dbając o jej stabilność, bezpieczeństwo i automatyzację.
Zaprojektujesz i rozwiniesz procesy wdrożeniowe oparte o Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Bicep i Helm. Będziesz wdrażać dobre praktyki GitOps, automatyczne walidacje, code review oraz integracje z narzędziami bezpieczeństwa.
Będziesz rozwijać klastry AKS, automatyzować wdrożenia aplikacji oraz wspierać zespoły developerskie w efektywnym korzystaniu z platformy. Ważnym elementem roli będzie również wdrażanie bezpiecznych i skalowalnych wzorców architektonicznych.
Zajmiesz się monitoringiem, observability oraz analizą incydentów, wykorzystując Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Prometheus i Grafanę. Będziesz współpracować z zespołami architektury, bezpieczeństwa, infrastruktury i aplikacji, tworząc standardy oraz dokumentację dla całej platformy.

Tech stack:

Azure | AKS | Kubernetes | Terraform | Bicep | Azure DevOps | GitHub Actions | GitHub Enterprise | Helm | ACR | Azure Monitor | Log Analytics | Application Insights | Managed Prometheus | Grafana | PowerShell | Bash | Python | Defender for Cloud | Sentinel

Wymagania:
Masz minimum 5 lat doświadczenia jako DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Platform Engineer lub na podobnym stanowisku.
Od co najmniej 3 lat pracujesz z Microsoft Azure.
Budowałeś i utrzymywałeś środowiska produkcyjne klasy enterprise.
Praktycznie wykorzystujesz Kubernetes, najlepiej Azure Kubernetes Service.
Swobodnie pracujesz z Terraform i Infrastructure as Code.
Projektowałeś oraz rozwijałeś pipeline'y CI/CD.
Korzystasz z Git, pull requestów, code review i pracy zespołowej nad kodem.
Rozumiesz znaczenie bezpieczeństwa, automatyzacji i zgodności procesowej.

Doświadczenie z AWS.
Znajomość ArgoCD, FluxCD lub innych narzędzi GitOps.
Doświadczenie z rozwiązaniami observability.
Znajomość ServiceNow, Jira i Confluence.
Doświadczenie z narzędziami CNAPP/CSPM/CWPP.

Oferujemy:

Będziesz współtworzyć strategiczną platformę Microsoft Azure dla krytycznych systemów instytucji finansowej.
Zyskasz realny wpływ na standardy Platform Engineering, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD i automatyzacji.

As Principal Software Engineer, you'll work directly with the Head of FinTech Engineering and business leadership, translating critical business goals - new product lines, regulatory deadlines, growth targets - into architecture decisions and roadmap input. new_jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Developer - TRATON Workshop Suite
new_jobs.description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com 

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. 

Role Summary

This role is part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden.

As a Full-Stack Software Developer
, you will join Team Jaguar, one of several cross-functional development teams working together to build the TRATON Workshop Suite (TWS)
– the digital workshop platform supporting technicians in servicing, maintaining and updating vehicles across the TRATON Group.

Team Jaguar is responsible for the Software Update domain
, developing user-facing functionality that enables workshop technicians to safely and efficiently update vehicle software. The team owns the functionality and user experience end-to-end, from the workshop application through backend and cloud services. To deliver the complete solution, we collaborate closely with other TWS teams and use shared capabilities such as product and vehicle communication services.

In this role, you will work across the full technology stack, primarily using C#/.NET, AWS and Angular
in a microservice-based architecture. The solutions you develop are ultimately used by workshop technicians in their daily work, giving the role a clear connection between the technology we build and the value it creates for our users.

You will be part of a team with shared responsibility for building, operating and continuously improving stable, secure and user-friendly solutions that support efficient workshop operations across the TRATON Group.

Job Responsibilities

Develop and maintain full-stack functionality within the Software Update domain, using C#/.NET, AWS and Angular across frontend, backend, microservices and APIs;
Build robust and user-friendly solutions that enable safe and reliable software updates of vehicles;
Take part in the complete software lifecycle – from requirements, design and implementation to testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, support and maintenance;
Collaborate closely with developers, testers, Product Owner and Scrum Master within the team, as well as with other teams across TWS;
Troubleshoot complex technical issues across frontend, backend, cloud services and integrations;
Continuously improve system stability, observability, maintainability, quality and user experience;
Contribute to testing and validation in development environments, rigs and real vehicles;
Contribute actively to the team's way of working, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

We believe you are a collaborative and curious full-stack software developer who enjoys solving real problems for end users and understanding the complete solution.

You have at least 3 years of relevant professional experience
and a solid foundation in software development. You don't need to have worked with every technology in our stack – what matters is that you have relevant experience, enjoy learning and can contribute effectively as part of a team.

You have experience with C#/.NET, cloud development such as AWS and microservice architectures
, combined with frontend development. Experience with Angular is preferred
, while experience with other modern frontend frameworks, such as React, is also valuable.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend development, but you should be comfortable working across both and willing to contribute wherever the team needs you.

For us, technical competence is only part of what makes a great developer. How you collaborate, communicate and contribute to the team is equally important.
We are looking for someone who enjoys working closely with others, shares knowledge, asks for help when needed and actively helps others succeed. We value shared ownership and believe that the best results are achieved together.

You are comfortable communicating with different audiences – from discussing technical details with fellow developers to explaining complex technical topics to stakeholders with different levels of technical knowledge. You can adapt your communication to your audience, making complex topics understandable without losing what is important. You listen to different perspectives and seek to understand the needs behind what we build.

You take initiative and ownership while staying aligned with the team. You are curious about the customer and want to understand not only how
something should be built, but why it matters to the people using it
.

Experience within automotive software, vehicle communication, distributed systems, DevOps, observability or similar technically complex environments is considered an advantage, but not a requirement. Most importantly, you are motivated to learn the domain, contribute to the team and grow together with us.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and value different experiences and perspectives. If you are excited about the role but don't meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply.

This Is Us

Team Jaguar
is a cross-functional team of developers and testers responsible for the Software Update domain within the TRATON Workshop Suite
.

Our solutions enable workshop technicians to perform software updates on vehicles, making our work both technically challenging and directly connected to the end-user experience. We develop across frontend, backend and cloud services and collaborate closely with other TWS teams whose capabilities together enable the complete workshop solution.

Jaguar is one of several teams that together develop the TRATON Workshop Suite. We have clear ownership of our domain while depending on and contributing to the wider TWS ecosystem. Close collaboration across team boundaries is therefore a natural part of how we work.

Within Jaguar, we work closely together and share responsibility for what we build and operate. Different experiences, perspectives and strengths make the team better
, and we help each other solve problems, share knowledge and learn along the way. We want an environment where people feel comfortable asking questions, contributing ideas and challenging existing solutions constructively.

We strive to work in an agile and iterative way
, with close collaboration, shared ownership and continuous improvement. As a team, we plan, build, evaluate, learn and adjust together, continuously looking for ways to improve both our solutions and how we work.

Joining Team Jaguar means becoming part of a collaborative team where you can work across the full technology stack, broaden your skills across frontend, backend and cloud development
, and contribute to solutions with a clear impact on workshop operations.

As part of the wider TRATON Workshop Suite development organization
, you will also be exposed to different technical domains, technologies and challenges, creating opportunities to broaden your experience and continue developing over time. You will have opportunities to learn from others, share your own expertise and grow together with the team as we continue developing the TRATON Workshop Suite.

TRATON Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-19. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Mattias Gustafsson, Unit Head - System Development Service Products - TGROSDS, mattias.gustafsson@scania.com

We look forward to your application!

This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group   R&D.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Om oss

Hos Winassist utvecklar vi en affärskritisk produktplattform som används varje dag av tusentals personer inom fordons- och verkstadsbranschen. Våra lösningar hjälper våra kunder att planera arbetet, ta hand om kunder och driva sina verksamheter effektivt.

Vi söker nu en senior utvecklare till vårt Core-team som vill arbeta brett, från en stor etablerad kodbas och komplex affärslogik till nya tjänster och moderna molnlösningar.

Ditt uppdrag

Core-teamet ansvarar för stora delar av kärnan i Winassists produkt. Här finns både affärskritiska system som utvecklats och förfinats under många år och vår nya plattform.

Teknikmiljön är därför bred. En stor del av vår befintliga produkt är utvecklad i Delphi, medan vår nya backend huvudsakligen utvecklas i Kotlin. Parallellt förflyttar vi vår plattform från on-prem mot SaaS.

Som senior utvecklare i Core kommer du att arbeta med både dagens produkt och vår nya plattform. Det kan innebära att vidareutveckla befintlig funktionalitet, bygga nytt eller bedöma när ett behov bör lösas i den nya plattformen. En viktig del av rollen är att kunna navigera i den här förflyttningen, göra pragmatiska tekniska avvägningar mellan dagens behov och vår långsiktiga arkitektur samt vara med och påverka hur vi utvecklar plattformen framåt.

AI är också en viktig del av rollen. Vi använder redan AI i utvecklingsarbetet och söker någon som har kommit långt praktiskt och vill hjälpa både teamet och våra arbetssätt att ta nästa steg.

Du kommer bland annat att

Utveckla och vidareutveckla våra affärskritiska system i framför allt Kotlin och Delphi.
Sätta dig in i och lösa komplexa problem i stora etablerade kodbaser, affärslogik och datamodeller.
Ta ägarskap för komplexa tekniska problem, från analys och lösningsdesign till implementation, verifiering och produktion.
Bygga nya tjänster och ta ansvar för tekniska beslut kring systemdesign, API:er, integrationer och data.
Arbeta hela vägen från utveckling till deployment och drift, inklusive CI/CD, konfiguration, observability och felsökning i produktion.
Ta en drivande roll i hur vi använder AI och AI-agenter i utvecklingsarbetet och hjälpa teamet att utveckla sina arbetssätt inom området.
Arbeta tillsammans med andra utvecklare, Tech Lead, Engineering Manager, produkt och QA för att lösa problem hela vägen från behov till produktion.

Vem vi tror att du är

Du är en erfaren backend- eller fullstackutvecklare som gillar att förstå helheten, se samband och ta dig an tekniska utmaningar som kräver både analys och pragmatism. Du är självgående, nyfiken, har ett eget driv och är van att ta tekniskt ansvar, men ser också senioritet som något som handlar om att göra teamet bättre, inte bara lösa dina egna uppgifter.

Du behöver inte kunna alla tekniker vi använder idag. Viktigare är att du har en stark grund inom mjukvaruutveckling och systemdesign och är van att sätta dig in i nya tekniska områden.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har gedigen erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och flera av följande områden:

Backendutveckling i exempelvis Kotlin, Java, C#/.NET eller liknande.
Systemdesign, API:er, integrationer och databaser.
Cloud och DevOps, där du själv arbetat med vägen från kod till deployment och drift.
CI/CD, automatiserade tester och moderna utvecklingsflöden.
Större etablerade kodbaser och system med komplex affärslogik.
AI som en integrerad del av ditt utvecklingsarbete.

Erfarenhet av GCP, Kotlin, Kubernetes, Terraform, Delphi, SaaS eller fordonsbranschen är meriterande.

Du behöver inte ha arbetat med Delphi tidigare, men du behöver vara öppen för att arbeta med det som en del av rollen.

AI är extra viktigt för den här rollen

Vi söker inte bara någon som använder AI för code completion eller enskilda frågor.

Vi vill att du har praktisk erfarenhet av mer avancerade AI-drivna utvecklingsflöden, exempelvis AI-agenter där modeller får relevant kontext och verktyg för att analysera kod, genomföra förändringar och verifiera resultat. Erfarenhet av exempelvis MCP, tool use eller motsvarande är meriterande.

Du behöver inte vara AI/ML-specialist eller ha erfarenhet av att träna egna modeller. Det viktiga är att du har experimenterat praktiskt, förstår både möjligheter och begränsningar och vet hur AI-genererat arbete behöver verifieras.

Vi vill också att du tycker det är kul att dela med dig av det du kan och hjälpa andra utvecklare att utveckla hur de arbetar med AI.

Det här erbjuder vi

Hos Winassist får du det bästa av två världar. Vi är ett etablerat och lönsamt produktbolag med stark kundbas och hög efterfrågan på våra lösningar, samtidigt som vi är tillräckligt små för att ha korta beslutsvägar och stora möjligheter att påverka.

Du får:

Arbeta nära produkten och se effekten av det du bygger hos tusentals användare.
Vara med och forma vår resa mot SaaS, molntjänster och AI-drivna arbetssätt.
Ta stort tekniskt ansvar och påverka arkitektur, teknikval och arbetssätt.
Arbeta tillsammans med erfarna kollegor som gärna delar kunskap och hjälper varandra.

Här möts du av ett engagerat team med hög arbetsglädje, nära samarbete och högt i tak.

Vi erbjuder bland annat hybridarbete, friskvårdstimme, kostnadsfritt gym i huset, och konkurrenskraftig tjänstepension.

Rollen är baserad i Häggvik norr om Stockholm, med möjlighet till hybridarbete. För mer information om hur det är att arbeta hos oss och våra förmåner, se https://winassist.se/karriar/

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Ansökan är öppen till och med 1 november.

Observera att detta är en rekrytering till en anställning hos Winassist. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar eller förslag från konsultbolag för denna tjänst.

Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° platform currently powers three solutions:

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

You're an engineering leader who still enjoys being close to the code. You care about your people as much as about the product, and you're comfortable balancing delivery, quality, and team growth.

Being a travel tech startup, Welcome continues to grow and scale its operations and is quickly becoming a global category leader for in-destination travel services.
One of the highest-rated global transportation companies with a rating of 4.9/5 stars.
Expanded from 200 destinations last year to 350, achieving our ambitious 2024 growth target.
Over 4,000 travel partners including 2,500 hotels, numerous vacation rentals, and travel agents, adding 50+ new ones every month.
Over 2.5 million happy travellers every year.

⭐️ If you want to dive deeper into the awesomeness of Welcome's culture, click
on this link
 to check our TikTok account.⭐️

The Team

We are a group of vibrant, diverse people who love travelling and never settle on quality. Each one of us didn't join Welcome by chance and believes deeply in what Welcome is trying to achieve, so we work relentlessly to make that happen. We challenge common logic, focus on design, put simplicity and usability first, and create memorable experiences. We keep learning and exploring better ways to serve our community and grow personally and professionally in our respective fields. We stay humble along the way, with a "pay it forward" mentality, but with big and bold goals.
As a Senior Platform Engineer
at Welcome Pickups ,
you will keep the platform behind our product reliable, fast, scalable and secure, so travellers, drivers and partners can count on our services every day. Much of what we do runs in the background: matching rides to drivers, pricing, notifications, partner syncs and payouts. If the platform slows down or stops, rides don't get assigned and travellers end up waiting at arrivals. This is a hands-on role that works across all our product teams. You will make key architecture and infrastructure decisions, set the standards everyone builds to, and own the technical roadmap together with the Product Manager of the Core team. The role is about helping product teams move fast without breaking things, not slowing them down.
What you'll work with

A large Ruby on Rails application, with Sidekiq and RabbitMQ
A large, fast-growing PostgreSQL/PostGIS database, plus Elasticsearch and Redis
Azure as our main cloud, with AWS S3 and Google Cloud
Cloud66, Cloudflare, CircleCI and Docker
New Relic and Rollbar for monitoring, and Mixpanel for product analytics
30+ external services, including Checkout.com, Twilio, Braze and hotel booking systems

Responsibilities

Reliability & Uptime

Define and track reliability targets (SLAs/SLOs) for our core flows: bookings, ride matching and payments.
Set up and run the incident process and on-call, and reduce recovery times.
Improve monitoring and alerting across the platform (New Relic, Rollbar).

Performance, Scalability & Data

Lead architecture decisions for scaling our backend systems and services.
Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the application, background jobs and database.
Improve the performance of our large, fast-growing PostgreSQL database:
tune slow queries and indexes
plan data growth and archiving
manage replication, backups and restore drills
change large tables without downtime

Make sure the platform handles peak season and partner growth smoothly.

Infrastructure, Security & Compliance

Define and evolve our infrastructure strategy on Azure, and balance performance, reliability and cost.
Define and enforce security best practices: access control, secrets management, and the security of our build and release pipeline.
Prepare the platform for compliance: payment-data rules (PCI), GDPR, and over time SOC 2 / ISO 27001.

Developer Experience

Software Development: Participate in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software applications to meet project requirements.
Design Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define design specifications and details, taking into account diverse perspectives.

Skills:

Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test the software, and resolve any software-related issues.
Software Development: The ability to design, write, test, and implement software programs, applications, and systems. This includes understanding various programming languages, software architecture, and software testing methods. It also involves problem-solving capabilities to fix software issues and improve functionality.
Programming: The ability to design, write, test, debug, and maintain the instructions, also known as code, that a computer must follow to execute a task. This skill often involves various programming languages such as C# and Angular.
Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and ultimately choosing and implementing the most effective course of action.
Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them down into smaller parts, and understand how these parts work together.
Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process, often in software or product development. It involves the ability to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality.
Agile: The ability to swiftly and effectively respond to changes, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and flexibility. In the context of project management, it denotes a methodology that promotes adaptive planning and encourages rapid and flexible responses to changes.
Source Code Repository: The ability to effectively use a source code repository, a file archive, and a web hosting facility where a large amount of source code, for software or for web pages, is kept, either publicly or privately. This skill involves the ability to manage and track changes to code, identify and fix issues, merge code from different branches, and collaborate with other developers.
Non-Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate a non-relational database (MongoDB).
APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage Application Programming Interfaces, which constitute the set of protocols and tools used for building application software. This skill includes the capacity to create and maintain high-quality API documentation, implement API security practices, and understand API testing techniques. Additionally, having this ability means understanding how APIs enable interaction between different software systems, allowing them to communicate with each other.
Design: The ability to create, conceptualize, sketch, and implement layouts, structures, and plans either for aesthetic or functional purposes. This could be used in various contexts such as architecture, fashion, graphics, interior, and more. It involves creativity, problem-solving, and strategic thinking.
Framework: The ability to understand, utilize, design, and develop complex structures and systems in various contexts such as programming, project management, or business strategy. This ability requires critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
Documentation: The ability to create, manage, organize, and maintain important information and documents in various physical and digital formats. This skill may include preparing reports, managing files, storing data, and keeping records organized and updated for easy retrieval and understanding.

Analytical Skills
Inclusive Collaboration
Drive to Perform
Accountability

new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm or Tallinn – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

You will join one of our product teams and on a daily basis:

Design, develop, test, and ship robust, maintainable, and readable software, applications, APIs, and other workflows
Initiate, participate in, and communicate technical architecture designs
Attend regular scrum ceremonies as a member of an agile cross-functional team
Analyze, discuss, and implement business requirements while maintaining good documentation of the systems and components you create
Bring in industry standards and best practices to continually improve our codebase and architecture
Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organisational and industry standards and practices

Qualifications

What you bring:

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Experience in developing, shipping, and maintaining cloud-based applications
Good knowledge and experience working with microservices and distributed architectures
A deep understanding and knowledge of RESTful APIs
Years of experience using relational databases, preferably SQL Server. Additionally, working knowledge of ORMs, preferably Entity Framework
Familiarity with cloud development; experience with Azure is a bonus
Practical knowledge of using messaging platforms in a distributed architecture (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka)
Knowledge and experience on a FinTech and banking industry is a plus
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, and sound judgement about reviewing and testing what they produce, is a plus
Fluent English

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Germany.

About The Technologies We Use

Our teams have autonomy when it comes to tech choices. The example below will give you some insights, and we are looking forward to discussing this further with you.

All solutions developed cloud-native targeting Azure - Infrastructure defined using Terraform - Services deployed to Kubernetes clusters by default - A growing microservice ecosystem with event-based integration - Using latest .NET Core - RESTful API design - Single-page frontend apps served by CDN - Frontend tech using TypeScript, often Angular or standard Web Components (Stencil) - Automated tests in each layer.
